hooks.command: sh -c 'root="${GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR:-}"; if [ -z "$root" ]; then root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || root="$PWD"; fi; if [ -x "$root/node_modules/.bin/agnostic-ai" ]; then exec "$root/node_modules/.bin/agnostic-ai" project -- hook memory --target gemini; fi; command -v agnostic-ai >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec agnostic-ai project -- hook memory --target gemini'
hooks.description: Load the shared memory index into the session.
